newsitem.title: USA: Brown Group Nov Famous Footwear sales up.
newsitem.headline: Brown Group Nov Famous Footwear sales up.

text.p: Brown Group Inc said Thursday that same store sales for its Famous Footwear division rose 0.4 percent for the four weeks ended November 30.
Total sales for Famous Footwear in November were $52.2 million, an increase of six percent.
Year-to-date sales for Famous Footwear increased 9.2 percent to $647.8 million and were up 1.1 percent on a same-store basis, it said.

The Naturalizer retail division's same store sales fell 10 percent for the month, while total sales decreased 11 percent to $10.0 million. For the year-to-date period, sales were down 0.2 percent to $109.5 million, but increased 0.9 percent on a same-store basis.

"November sales at Famous Footwear reflect the impact of a lower level of promotional footwear in the stores, and reduced advertising during this low-volume month," Harry Rich, executive vice president and chief financial officer, said in a statement. "Although same store sales were relatively flat, margins were higher than planned in November."

He added that November was a "particularly difficult" month for Naturalizer's retail sales, with the promotional Veterans Day week contributing to the same store sales decline. "Inventories continue to be clean and slightly below plan," Rich said. "As at Famous Footwear, a less promotional mix of product compared to last year also contributed to the sales decline in November."
